name: RegulatorySubmission
description: A regulatory submission record tracking submissions to the PRA, FCA, or other regulatory authorities. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005). The stress test PRA submission is one instance of this entity. Other submissions (e.g. ICAAP, regulatory returns) reuse the same entity.

fields.name: submission_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this regulatory submission

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: FK to PER-059 who made the submission

relationships.description: RegulatorySubmission references StressTestExercise for stress test submissions

design_decisions: RegulatorySubmission is a general-purpose entity owned by SVC-015 to capture all regulatory submissions. Stress test submission is one instance.
This entity will be reused by future journeys (ICAAP, Pillar 3, RMAR) avoiding fragmentation of regulatory submission tracking.
